## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## 🎯 Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or gap in SigmaOS? Explain the background and motivation.

## 📐 Architecture & Security Design
- **Subsystem**:
- **`no_std` Compliance**: How will this remain zero-dependency and std-free?
- **Capability Security**: Which capability tokens will be required to invoke this feature?
- **Memory Safety**: How will allocations be handled (Paged vs. NonPaged pools)?

## 🔬 Proposed Acceptance Criteria
- Unit test(s) verifying behavior
- Integration or QEMU smoke test scenario
